review.note: Retracted in M22: the FP-25's raid on a Grupo 8 cash van in Lisbon on 7 February 1984, which took 108 thousand contos. The atlas holds no record of the armed far left — not the PRP-BR, not the FP-25, not the trials — so there is nothing for an action of theirs to attach to in either direction, and any edge would be invented. Revisit once the organisations themselves are here.

title: Assault on the Grupo 8 cash van, in Lisbon, carried out by the FP-25, which yielded 108 thousand contos, on February 7, 1984
summary: Wikidata item Q115779750, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Assault carried out by Forças Populares 25 de Abril, at the exit of Banco Fonsecas & Burnay, in Lisbon". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
